children: Warehouse giant Costco Wholesale Corp. (COST, Financials) focused on paid memberships and bulk purchasing is altering how customers can get inside its locations.
DoorDash is rolling out same-day delivery from Costco warehouses nationwide, just a day after Uber Eats expanded its own Costco service to 48 states.
The timing is something to observe. Costco had 82.9 million members as of June yet membership growth was down 4% year-over-year.

This matters because the membership fees are an important aspect of Costco's business model, delivering the corporation a continuous supply of high-margin revenue while helping to foster consumer loyalty. It's not about immediate sales.
Costco's net sales for fiscal 2026 were $297.3 billion, up 10% from the prior year. But its stock is up only around 4% this year, compared with a gain of more than 10% for the S&P 500.
Another option to get to consumers without a visit to the warehouse is Costco's relationships with DoorDash and Uber.
These could be especially crucial for younger consumers, a group Costco has had problems about how to attract and retain.
The next challenge is to see if convenience can do more than create delivery orders. Costco needs to determine if its expanded digital footprint can lead to faster membership growth.

title: Costco expands DoorDash and Uber delivery as membership growth slows
